basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old mom living in the beautiful Pacific Northwest. I recently got into Reddit as a way to connect with other parents and share the humorous and sometimes challenging moments of parenting. I'm a part-time graphic designer and enjoy hiking and exploring local trails with my family during my free time. My husband and I have a lively 3-year-old son who keeps us on our toes. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after my little one is asleep. I'm interested in parenting communities, but also keep an eye on health updates, especially related to COVID-19 in our region.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design and work part-time in the field, which keeps me up to date with creative trends. My parenting knowledge is mostly hands-on, learned through experience and advice shared in communities like breakingmom. I've also been closely following COVID-19 updates, especially those affecting my area in Oregon.
